PlanRequest.description: Judge-facing: a syllabus goes in (the document itself, or a reference the evidence fetcher can resolve), a receipt + plan comes out.

PlanResponse.description: ALWAYS a receipt (HTTP 200). On any agent/model error the deterministic gate loop executes and the receipt carries execution_class=offline-gate + fail_closed=true. There is no 5xx response shape for POST /plan — that absence is the fail-closed floor, and it is deliberate.

ReceiptLookupResponse.description: GET /receipt/{id}: the stored receipt, byte-identical to the one the invocation returned (receipts are content-stamped by receipt_sha256). An unknown id is the endpoint's ONLY 404.

description: The judge-facing HTTP surface. POST /plan · GET /health · GET /receipt/{id}. THE FAIL-CLOSED FLOOR: POST /plan has no 5xx shape at all — the endpoint never 500s a judge; model failure degrades to the deterministic gate loop and the receipt says so (fail_closed).
title: StudySprint endpoint API — with the fail-closed floor
